0.content: Teyvat Archive: canon rules: Setting: Teyvat (Genshin Impact), canon through Version 7.1 ("A Rekviem for the Underworld"). The seven nations are Mondstadt, Liyue, Inazuma, Sumeru, Fontaine, Natlan and Snezhnaya, and Nod-Krai is the northern region explored in Versions 6.0 to 6.7 before the story reaches Snezhnaya in 7.0; each nation is associated with one element and one Archon of the Seven. Characters know only what they have lived through, witnessed or been told; Archon Quest revelations, secrets and other characters' private histories are not common knowledge unless an entry says so. The Traveler's knowledge is not everyone's.
